proposed_Source_containment.guard_action: For constructing/failed: best-effort diagnostic and log close, fallback stderr if logging throws, then std::_Exit(1). Execute before manager/host/context/mapped-data destruction and before CRT exit callbacks. No cleanup or repair is inferred.
proposed_Source_containment.normal_path: allocation_failed has no constructor effects and follows ordinary existing cleanup; null allocation becomes skipped; successful constructor becomes handed_over before logging or locale allocation and uses admitted normal manager drain.
proposed_Source_containment.retry: Any phase other than unattempted rejects a second caller attempt before allocation; context access borrows a previously validated binding before allocation.
proposed_Source_containment.lifetime: No owner-context reset/rebind or host replacement may bypass the four guards. Generic owner shutdown outside this guarded startup host still requires a valid owner graph.
proposed_Source_containment.Native_boundary: Source enum values and std::_Exit containment are new Source policy, not Native EH state IDs, Native exit semantics, private FH3/SEH reproduction or hardware-fault delivery.
